announcement.transcript: Attention all students! There will be a guest lecture on climate change this Thursday at 6 PM in the auditorium. Don't miss out on this opportunity to learn from an expert in the field. We hope to see you there!

questions.q: What is the topic of the guest lecture?
questions.explain: 客座講座的主題是氣候變化。

questions.q: When will the lecture take place?

talk.transcript: Today, we will discuss the concept of biodiversity. Biodiversity refers to the variety of life in a particular habitat or ecosystem. It includes the diversity of species, genetic variation, and the variety of ecosystems. Biodiversity is crucial for ecosystem health and resilience, providing essential services such as clean air, water, and food. Loss of biodiversity can lead to ecosystem collapse and jeopardize the resources that humans rely on. Protecting biodiversity is not only beneficial for the environment but also vital for human well-being.
